paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Vayechi 6: he walked with R’ Elazar at the gateway outside Tiberias. There are other readings there; see also the entry Kovess.[^1]

notes.text: The matching episode is in the consulted Buber Tanchuma, Vayechi 6:2. Its titles are abbreviated R’, retained here without choosing Rav or Rabbi. Hyman’s unspecific Tanchuma citation and mention of variant readings remain visible.
